scanner_c.notes: Strict Sep 10 Toronto-morning previous-24h scan across the U.S., mainland China/Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Europe, with technology and U.S.-equity relevance prioritized. Major claims were verified primarily with Reuters and company/official sources where available. Ten distinct topics were retained without duplicate padding.

items.event_title: TSMC August revenue jumps 53.3% to a record NT$514.8 billion as AI demand persists
items.news_summary: TSMC reported record August revenue of about NT$514.8 billion, up 53.3% year over year and 10.1% month over month, reinforcing that advanced-node AI demand remains exceptionally strong.
items.investor_materiality: Direct read-through to Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom and the wider AI accelerator/foundry supply chain; record revenue also supports TSMC pricing and capacity-expansion power.
items.selection_reason: One of the clearest fresh hard-data signals for the global AI semiconductor cycle.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters-syndicated report; figures also align with TSMC monthly-revenue reporting framework.
items.youtube_query: TSMC TSM August revenue AI demand
items.video_angle: 台积电8月营收暴增53%：AI芯片需求到底还在加速，还是已经透支？

items.entity: China AI chip / HBM supply chain
items.event_title: Chinese AI chipmakers raise prices as HBM shortage bites
items.news_summary: Reuters reported Huawei, Cambricon, MetaX and Iluvatar CoreX are raising AI accelerator prices as advanced HBM remains scarce and expensive under export restrictions; Huawei's newer cards have seen large price increases.
items.investor_materiality: Directly affects the competitive economics of Nvidia alternatives in China and strengthens the strategic value of HBM suppliers SK Hynix, Samsung and Micron.
items.selection_reason: Combines China AI-chip competition, U.S. export controls and the global memory bottleneck in one identifiable catalyst.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters exclusive based on industry sources.
items.youtube_query: China AI chips HBM shortage Huawei Micron
items.video_angle: 中国AI芯片突然涨价20%-50%：真正卡脖子的可能不是GPU，而是HBM。

items.event_title: Nvidia targets up to 2 GW of new Australian AI data-center capacity by 2027
items.news_summary: Nvidia said it is working with Australian partners including Firmus, CDC, NEXTDC and AirTrunk to build up to 2 GW of AI-related computing capacity by 2027 using its DSX platform.
items.investor_materiality: Signals continued global AI infrastructure buildout and highlights electricity/data-center capacity as the next constraint beyond GPU supply.
items.selection_reason: Large identifiable infrastructure expansion with direct NVDA and data-center power-chain relevance.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters report based on Nvidia's announcement.
items.youtube_query: NVDA Nvidia Australia 2GW AI data center
items.video_angle: NVIDIA把AI工厂扩到澳洲2GW：下一轮AI瓶颈为什么越来越像是电力。

items.entity: South Korea U.S. AI infrastructure investment
items.event_title: South Korea nears more than $100 billion U.S. investment package centered on AI infrastructure and power
items.news_summary: Reuters, citing the Wall Street Journal, reported South Korea is nearing an agreement for more than $100 billion in U.S. investments that could include up to eight nuclear reactors and a Texas gas plant supporting AI data centers.
items.investor_materiality: Major potential tailwind for U.S. AI data centers, power equipment, nuclear supply chains and Korean semiconductor-linked capital spending.
items.selection_reason: The scale is unusually large and directly connects geopolitics, tariffs, power infrastructure and AI capex.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters report citing WSJ; final terms are still under negotiation, so amounts and project scope should be treated as proposed.
items.youtube_query: South Korea $100B US AI infrastructure nuclear
items.video_angle: 韩国准备向美国砸1000亿美元：AI竞争已经从芯片升级到核电和天然气。

items.event_title: OpenAI faces U.S. Senate probe over Hugging Face AI-agent security incident
items.news_summary: A U.S. Senate subcommittee is investigating OpenAI's handling of a cybersecurity incident involving AI agents and Hugging Face, with lawmakers seeking documents and answers from CEO Sam Altman.
items.investor_materiality: Raises regulatory and enterprise-safety risk for the agent ecosystem and has read-through to Microsoft, Meta, Anthropic and AI-security spending.
items.selection_reason: Fresh regulatory escalation tied to a concrete AI-agent security incident rather than generic AI-safety commentary.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters plus Axios reporting on a formal Senate inquiry.
items.youtube_query: OpenAI Hugging Face Senate probe AI agents
items.video_angle: OpenAI被美国参议院调查：AI Agent失控事件会不会变成下一轮监管导火索？

items.event_title: Analog Devices to acquire Alif Semiconductor for $1.35 billion
items.news_summary: Analog Devices agreed to buy edge-AI chip developer Alif Semiconductor for $1.35 billion in cash, with potential additional contingent payments.
items.investor_materiality: Expands ADI into low-power edge AI processing and illustrates consolidation around on-device intelligence, sensing and industrial AI.
items.selection_reason: Concrete semiconductor M&A with a clear strategic rationale and identifiable transaction value.
items.youtube_query: ADI Analog Devices Alif Semiconductor acquisition
items.video_angle: ADI花13.5亿美元买Alif：AI芯片战为什么开始从数据中心打到终端设备。

items.event_title: Samsung and Mistral AI form semiconductor manufacturing AI partnership
items.news_summary: Samsung will deploy Mistral AI models and services across semiconductor engineering and manufacturing, including on-premises systems for sensitive chip-design and production data; Samsung also led Mistral's latest funding round.
items.investor_materiality: Connects frontier AI directly to memory/foundry manufacturing efficiency and may affect Samsung's competitiveness against SK Hynix and TSMC.
items.selection_reason: Officially announced cross-border partnership with a concrete semiconductor-production use case.
items.video_angle: Samsung把Mistral塞进芯片工厂：AI下一步不是卖模型，而是直接提高良率？

items.event_title: OpenAI says cooperation with Samsung is deepening around next-generation chips
items.news_summary: OpenAI said cooperation with Samsung is progressing in next-generation semiconductor research and production alongside broader enterprise AI adoption, though it stressed there was no new standalone product announcement.
items.investor_materiality: Relevant to Samsung memory/foundry positioning, OpenAI's custom-chip roadmap and the broader TSMC/Broadcom/Nvidia supply-chain debate.
items.selection_reason: Fresh confirmation of deepening chip cooperation from a major AI buyer with significant semiconductor capex implications.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters; note that OpenAI explicitly said this was an update on existing cooperation rather than a wholly new deal.
items.video_angle: OpenAI为什么同时拉上Samsung、TSMC和Broadcom？自研芯片供应链正在成形。

items.event_title: Salesforce reportedly in talks to buy AI research startup Listen Labs for around $2 billion
items.news_summary: TechCrunch reported Listen Labs abandoned a signed financing term sheet amid acquisition discussions with Salesforce, with separate reporting placing a potential deal around $2 billion; talks are not finalized.
items.investor_materiality: Would extend Salesforce's AI stack into automated customer research and highlights aggressive valuations for application-layer AI assets.
items.selection_reason: Potential material AI M&A for a large U.S. software company, with a clear valuation and strategic angle.
items.source_quality_note: TechCrunch sourced reporting; transaction remains unconfirmed and may not close.
items.youtube_query: Salesforce CRM Listen Labs acquisition AI
items.video_angle: Salesforce可能20亿美元收购Listen Labs：AI应用层估值又被重新抬高了吗？

items.event_title: Tencent-backed Enflame raises $912 million ahead of Shanghai STAR Market debut
items.news_summary: Chinese AI chipmaker Enflame raised about $912 million in its IPO and is set to debut on Shanghai's STAR Market, with Tencent remaining its largest shareholder.
items.investor_materiality: Adds a new public-market valuation benchmark for China's domestic AI accelerators and provides competitive context for Nvidia and other AI-chip suppliers.
items.selection_reason: Large identifiable AI-chip IPO with strong strategic relevance to China-U.S. semiconductor competition.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters report with IPO size, valuation and ownership details.
items.youtube_query: Enflame IPO Tencent China AI chip
items.video_angle: 腾讯系AI芯片公司燧原上市：这是中国版NVIDIA估值体系的开始吗？
